title: Erkennung von Secrets
description: As a security admin, I want credentials that slipped into a prompt to be found, so that no API key ends up in the registry.

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates a prompt that contains a live-looking API key
acceptance_criteria.then: the version reaches status FLAGGED with a finding of category SECRET
and: the excerpt shows only a masked fragment of the key
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-019-secret-detection.feature: An API key leads to a flagged prompt

acceptance_criteria.given: a developer creates a prompt that contains the placeholder YOUR_API_KEY
acceptance_criteria.then: no SECRET finding is raised and the version is not flagged for that reason
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-019-secret-detection.feature: A placeholder is not treated as a secret

acceptance_criteria.given: a prompt contains a secret and the scan runs
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider is called for the classification
acceptance_criteria.then: the secret is reported as a finding and the version is FLAGGED
and: the content is transmitted unchanged to the AI service - this exposure is accepted per decision F1 and is recorded in the audit trail as metadata without content
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-019-secret-detection.feature: A detected secret is reported and the transmission is recorded
